A car is driven from rest on a long straight road. The car engine exerts a constant driving force.
The diagram shows the horizontal forces acting on the car. The resistive forces are proportional
to the speed of the car.

Why does the car eventually reach a maximum speed?
A
The resistive forces decrease to make the acceleration of the car negative.
B
The resistive forces decrease to make the acceleration of the car zero.
C
The resistive forces increase to make the acceleration of the car negative.
D
The resistive forces increase to make the acceleration of the car zero.
